title: A work order's tier prices new parts by its current rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  10. Check matrix A.
  11. Type 20 in the bulk bar's value.
  12. Click Set Rule.
  13. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  14. Open work order 1.
  15. Click Add Part under line 1.
  16. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  17. Type 1 in Qty.
  18. Pick category A in Category.
  19. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  20. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The part fills in at $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).

Step 8:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 9:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 10:

  • The bulk bar shows the count 1.

Step 11:

  • % Off is picked with the value 20.

Step 12:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 13:

  • Matrix A's row reads 20% off.

Step 14:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 15:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 16:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 17:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 18:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 19:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 20:

  • The new part fills in at $108.00 ($135.00 × 0.80 = $108.00).
  • The first part keeps $121.50.
